amenorrhea in 2018.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 2008 she had her first\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003ELSCS\u003C\/b\u003E, and was diagnosed with\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003Eeclampsia\u003C\/b\u003E, there was 1 episode of seizures during labor, otherwise it was a full term delivery.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 2012 she had yet another\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003ELSCS\u003C\/b\u003E, as she had\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003Epre eclampsia\u003C\/b\u003E, the LSCS was done 2 weeks prior to full term, she had a girl child 2.5 Kgs birth weight.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 2015 when she was 12 weeks far, she had a history of fall (slipped) and later had\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003Ebleeding PV\u003C\/b\u003E, for which her obstetrician advised abortion due to her history of eclampsia.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 2019 she experienced chest pain associated with sudden onset sob, she was rushed to KIMS NKP, where she was diagnosed with\u0026nbsp;\u003Cb\u003EHTN\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;for which she was given TELMA 40 mg and was advised for admission (hypertensive urgency) , but left against medical advice.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 2021 she started experiencing chest pain associated with cold sensation all over the body since 2 months. She had 2 - 3 episodes last month.
